MODULE.NON_RESPONSIBILITY: No duplicate /v1 or /v2 handlers and no rewriting of working conversation logic.

MODULE.RESPONSIBILITY: Existing BFE Drive Internal Auth UDS plus DPoP-only caller validation, independent conversation membership/role checks and WebSocket revocation.

Inspect repository schema definitions and call sites to identify obsolete legacy components. Do not inspect production data, implement migration or support old clients; preserve the direct/group model. Database destruction is outside Developer authority.
MODULE.NON_RESPONSIBILITY: Cannot authorize DB migration, deployment, merges or client cutover.

MODULE.RESPONSIBILITY: Direct/group creation, ownership and roles, membership epochs, private hide and concurrent direct uniqueness.
Ordered idempotent messages, history filtered by membership periods, document metadata without Drive grants, monotonic read markers.
Centrifuge authorized fan-out, membership/delivery ordering, revocation, reconnect and multi-device.

Repository route/schema inventory -> approved target contracts -> authorized obsolete-code/schema cleanup -> existing quality gates -> Release Manager deployment decision.
ISSUE32_DEVELOPMENT_REVISION.GATE: Requirements and Technology approval first; DevelopmentPlan approval then module and class/function contracts; mental scenarios and check criteria precede any production code cleanup. No migration or legacy-client support. Release Manager owns integration/deployment decisions.
